mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST < 1050 and RSAFS < 380000) signal weak consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signals a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1000 thousand units signal weak housing market demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: Declining employment (PAYEMS falling) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE rising) signals labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220) triggers a monetary tightening regime, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 110) signals strengthening economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive mean returns).
